name: query_music
description: Searches for song information based on semantic similarity with keywords, artist, and genre, returning a list of matching songs. Each song contains detailed information such as title, artist, genre, duration, description, URL, and song keywords.

artist.description: Artist name, supports fuzzy matching (case-insensitive), e.g. 'Taylor Swift', 'Ed Sheeran'

genre.description: Song genre, exact match (case-insensitive), must be one of the specified values

keywords.description: List of keywords for semantic search, e.g. ['happy', 'energetic', 'dance']
